project_title: JK Eden Huts Restaurant — Private Hut Dining Landing Page

theme_and_atmosphere.style: Tropical, warm organic rustic theme with earthy elegance
theme_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Intimate, welcoming, aromatic dining escape. Warm lantern illumination, natural bamboo texture, deep jungle foliage feel.

fonts.heading_font: Playfair Display, serif (import via Google Fonts in index.html if needed, or fallback to Georgia, serif)

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-bold tracking-tight
hierarchy.small_label: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium uppercase tracking-widest text-amber-700

sections.name: Header / Navigation
sections.description: Sticky top navigation bar with translucent backdrop (bg-[#14532D]/95 backdrop-blur-md), logo with bamboo icon, nav links (Home, About, Private Huts, Menu, Mandi & Tandoor, Reviews, Location), Phone call action button, and Reserve Hut CTA button.

sections.name: Hero Section
sections.description: Full-width immersive section with warm lantern bamboo hut background, subtle dark gradient overlay (from-black/70 via-black/40 to-transparent), headline 'Private Hut Dining, Sizzling Tandoor & Arabian Mandi in Bellandur', CTA buttons ('Book a Hut', 'Explore Menu', 'Call Now'), and trust badges (4.0★ rated 4800+ Google reviews, Private Huts available, Open till 1:00 AM late night, Free delivery up to 3km).

sections.name: Stats Banner
sections.description: Warm bamboo brown section with key metrics: 4800+ 5-Star Reviews, 15+ Private Bamboo Huts, 50+ Arabian & Tandoori Specialties, 100% Halal Certified.

sections.name: Dining Experience Story
sections.description: 2-column layout showcasing story of JK Eden Huts: intimate hut dining experience, fragrant Arabian rice spices cooked in traditional handis, flame-roasted Alfham grills, and family/couple seating privacy in Bellandur.

sections.name: Private Huts Showcase
sections.description: Grid of hut categories (Couples Private Hut, Family Hut 6-8 pax, Large Celebration Hut), with capacity tags, curtains/cooling amenities, price range guidance, and 'Book This Hut' action modal trigger.

sections.name: Menu Highlights Section
sections.description: Interactive section with tab filters (All, Arabian Mandi, Tandoor & Grills, Curries & Breads, Beverages & Desserts), Search bar, Veg/Non-Veg filter toggles, dish cards featuring images, ₹ pricing in INR, badges (Bestseller, Chef's Special, Halal Certified), portion sizes, and 'Inquire / Order' button.

sections.name: Customer Reviews & Wall of Love
sections.description: Grid/Carousel of authentic customer testimonials with star ratings, reviewer names, review date, verified customer badges, and highlighted quotes about hut atmosphere & Mandi taste.

sections.name: Hut Booking & Inquiry Form
sections.description: Client-side interactive reservation form with fields (Full Name, Phone Number, Date, Time Slot, Party Size, Preferred Hut Type, Special Requests), real-time validation, and instant simulated confirmation modal & toast notification using Sonner.

sections.name: Location, Hours & Direct Contact
sections.description: Map & contact info section in Bellandur, Bengaluru. Highlights late night hours (12:00 PM – 1:00 AM), direct Tel link, WhatsApp chat link, Google Maps directions button, and delivery radius details.

sections.name: Footer
sections.description: Rich dark jungle green footer with brand story, menu shortcuts, hut booking links, contact info, social links, and copyright text.

component_guidelines.icons: Use lucide-react (Utensils, MapPin, Phone, Clock, Star, Flame, Calendar, Users, ShieldCheck, Search, ChevronRight, MessageSquare, Menu, X, Heart, Award, Wine, Sparkles)
component_guidelines.toasts: Use sonner for instant booking confirmation toasts and order added notifications
component_guidelines.modals_dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for Hut Booking Modal and Dish Quick View Modal
component_guidelines.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg with smooth hover scaling (`hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all`), copper accent (`bg-[#C2410C] hover:bg-[#9A3412] text-white`) or lantern amber (`bg-[#D97706] hover:bg-[#B45309] text-white`)
component_guidelines.cards: White background (`bg-white`), subtle shadow (`shadow-md hover:shadow-xl transition-shadow`), border (`border border-amber-950/10`), rounded 2xl corners

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a responsive, highly polished single-page landing application in JS/React for JK Eden Huts Restaurant.
Implement the exact color scheme: Jungle Green (#14532D), Bamboo Timber Brown (#854D0E), Lantern Amber (#D97706), Cream Linen (#FDFBF7), Card White (#FFFFFF), and Copper Accent (#C2410C).
DO NOT use raw transparent backgrounds for sticky headers or dropdowns. Header must use solid or high-opacity backdrop-blur (`bg-[#14532D]/95 backdrop-blur-md text-white`).
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, links, forms) has a distinct `data-testid` attribute using kebab-case role-based naming.

Include client-side interactive state: Menu search, Category filtering tabs, Veg/Non-Veg filter toggles, Hut Booking inquiry form submit handling with Sonner toast feedback, and quick dish detail modal view.
Include authentic INR prices (e.g. ₹420 for Chicken Mandi, ₹780 for Mutton Mandi Platter, ₹340 for Tandoori Full, ₹260 for Butter Chicken).
Make sure images from `image_urls` are correctly placed in corresponding food cards, hero background, and hut sections.
